names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 3 august, «Sfânta Salomeea, mironosița», with the rank word left off.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 3 Αυγούστου, «Αγία Σαλώμη η Μυροφόρος», with the rank word and the epithet left off.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue’s fourth heading for the Julian 3 August, „Св. Саломија мироносица.“ — Св. is not a rank and is dropped with мироносица, which **is** a rank word and which this corpus has no type for; the stripping is recorded in the row note. What is left is the name alone, which `.tmp/sr-foldpred.mjs` reports folds with nothing. The book writes Саломија where the Greek gives Σαλώμη and the Romanian Salomeea; copied as printed.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 3 august — «Sfânta Salomeea, mironosița»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 3ης Αυγούστου — «Αγία Σαλώμη η Μυροφόρος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 3 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries. The page gives no year, so no `dates` object is proposed. It makes her «πρώτη εξαδέλφη της Παναγίας», first cousin of the Theotokos, with Zebedee for husband and James and John for sons; the same site, glossing the name Ιωάννης on its page for 3 Αυγούστου at https://www.saint.gr/2201/saint.aspx, calls her instead «Σαλώμης, αδελφής της Θεοτόκου», the Theotokos's sister. saint.gr says both things on one day and this reader does not choose between them: the cousin is what her own page says and is what the life paragraph follows, and the discrepancy is recorded here and in the report. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. The page prints no apolytikion and no kontakion, so no hymn is added.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 16.08.2026 (3. август ст. ст.) — „Св. Саломија мироносица.“

attestations.note: The day’s fourth and last entry, two sentences, and the Romanian and Greek both keep her on this same 3/8. **THREE KINSHIPS IN ONE SENTENCE, AND THE CORPUS HELD ONE OF THEM HALF-WAY AND TWO NOT AT ALL.** „Мати св. апостола Јакова и Јована, жена Заведејева, а кћи Јосифа обручника Пресвете Богородице.“ — mother of the holy apostles James and John, wife of Zebedee, and daughter of Joseph the Betrothed of the Most Holy Mother of God. Kinship is a relation, and these are kinships stated outright rather than inferred: `james-son-of-zebedee` and `joseph-the-betrothed` are written both ways and neither had any row to this folder, and **`john-the-theologian` was `related` here already and did not relate back** — thirty-nine rows on that folder and this one not among them — so the reciprocal is supplied, which makes this the second one-way row this block has found and completed. Zebedee himself holds no folder and takes nothing. **AND THE RANK IN THE HEADING IS ONE THIS CORPUS STILL HAS NO TYPE FOR, FOR THE SECOND TIME IN THIS WAVE.** „Св. Саломија мироносица.“: Св. is not a rank; мироносица, myrrh-bearer, is a rank word, it is in the heading, and by the standing rule it ought to be written — and `grep -ho types` over the corpus still returns no myrrh-bearer type anywhere. **This folder’s `types` is `null` before and after**, as it was before this reading, the Romanian «mironosița» and the Greek «Μυροφόρος» having given it nothing either. **AUTHOR: this is the same question the Julian 27 June raised on `joanna-the-myrrhbearer`, and it is now two folders whose one rank word the vocabulary cannot express.** **NO `dates`.** „Служила Господу за време Његовог земаљског живота и удостојила се бити међу првовесницима васкрсења Његовог.“ — she served the Lord during His earthly life and was counted worthy to be among the first messengers of His resurrection — is the whole of the rest, and there is no year, no age and no reign in the entry. No `locations`. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion: the day carries the verse only, which is Bishop Nikolai’s own and belongs to no person.
